summary: A single clickable link inside the page navigation menu.
description: A navigation button intended to change the selected view within a moz-page-nav. Renders as a tab-role button by default, or as a link (external href or SUMO support-page) when href/supportPage is set. Defined as a second customElements.define in the same file as moz-page-nav (class MozPageNavButton), documented here as its own component.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: Optional URL for an external link if not a support page URL; when set, the button renders as an <a target="_blank"> instead of a <button>.

attributes.name: iconSrc
attributes.description: The chrome:// URL for the icon used for the button (reflected attribute).

attributes.name: selected
attributes.description: Whether the button is currently selected; managed by the parent moz-page-nav based on currentView, but reflects the button's own state.

attributes.name: supportPage
attributes.description: Optional short name for a support page a secondary link should launch to (attribute: support-page); when set, renders as a moz-support-link anchor.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Title used for the button or link; should always be set so the control is still identifiable when moz-page-nav is collapsed and its slotted text is hidden. Used in shadow DOM, not reflected as an attribute on the host.

attributes.name: view
attributes.description: Read via getAttribute("view") (not a declared Lit property) — identifies which view this button activates; compared against the parent moz-page-nav's currentView.

slots.name: (default)
slots.description: Used to append the button's (typically l10n) label text.

events.name: change-view
events.description: Fired (bubbles, composed) when the button is activated, so the parent moz-page-nav can update currentView/selection.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Dispatches the change-view event and focuses the underlying button/link element. Accepts an options object with an optional focusVisible flag; called by moz-page-nav for keyboard arrow navigation between buttons.
